diff --git a/server/opensandbox_server/services/validators.py b/server/opensandbox_server/services/validators.py
index 4b37b570..4b72b6c9 100644
--- a/server/opensandbox_server/services/validators.py
+++ b/server/opensandbox_server/services/validators.py
@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@ enforce the same preconditions before performing runtime-specific work.
 
 from __future__ import annotations
 
+import os
 from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
 from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence
 
@@ -469,6 +470,77 @@ def ensure_valid_host_path(
                 },
             )
 
+    # ── Symbolic-link escape check ──
+    #
+    # ``os.path.normpath`` / the lexical prefix checks above only inspect the
+    # literal path string.  Docker resolves symbolic links when it performs a
+    # bind mount, so a symlink that lives *inside* an allowed prefix (e.g.
+    # /data/opensandbox/escape -> /) would pass the lexical checks yet mount an
+    # arbitrary host path.  We close that hole the same way ``_validate_pvc_volume``
+    # does: resolve the path with ``os.path.realpath`` and re-check that the
+    # canonical result still sits under one of the allowed prefixes.
+    #
+    # On Windows (or when the path does not exist on this host) there is no
+    # POSIX symlink to resolve, so the realpath check is a no-op and we keep
+    # the existing lexical behaviour.
+    _path_fwd = path.replace("\\", "/")
+    _is_windows_path = bool(re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:/", _path_fwd))
+    if not _is_windows_path:
+        # First, explicitly reject any intermediate path component that is a
+        # symlink.  This catches even cases where the target happens to stay
+        # inside the allowed prefix, and it fails fast with a clear message.
+        try:
+            _parent = path
+            while _parent and _parent != "/":
+                if os.path.islink(_parent):
+                    raise HTTPException(
+                        status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
+                        detail={
+                            "code": SandboxErrorCodes.HOST_PATH_NOT_ALLOWED,
+                            "message": (
+                                f"Host path '{path}' contains a symbolic link "
+                                f"component ('{_parent}'). Symlinked host paths are not allowed."
+                            ),
+                        },
+                    )
+                _parent = os.path.dirname(_parent)
+        except HTTPException:
+            raise
+        except OSError:
+            # Cannot stat an intermediate component (e.g. permission denied on
+            # a root-owned dir).  Fall through to the realpath check below,
+            # which is best-effort for the same reason.
+            pass
+
+        # Second, resolve the full path (following any symlinks) and confirm
+        # the canonical location is still within an allowed prefix.  ``strict``
+        # is not used so that a non-existent but correctly-located path (to be
+        # created by ``_validate_host_volume``) is still accepted, while an
+        # escaping symlink is rejected.
+        try:
+            _resolved = os.path.realpath(path)
+        except OSError:
+            _resolved = None
+        if _resolved is not None and allowed_prefixes is not None:
+            _resolved_norm = _resolved.replace("\\", "/")
+            _still_allowed = any(
+                _resolved_norm == _normalize_prefix_path(prefix)
+                or _resolved_norm.startswith(_normalize_prefix_path(prefix) + "/")
+                for prefix in allowed_prefixes
+            )
+            if not _still_allowed:
+                raise HTTPException(
+                    status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
+                    detail={
+                        "code": SandboxErrorCodes.HOST_PATH_NOT_ALLOWED,
+                        "message": (
+                            f"Host path '{path}' resolves (via symbolic link) to "
+                            f"'{_resolved}', which is not under any allowed prefix. "
+                            f"Allowed prefixes: {allowed_prefixes}"
+                        ),
+                    },
+                )
+
 
 def ensure_valid_pvc_name(claim_name: str) -> None:
     """
